entities.name: L5 nerve root
observations: At risk of compression or injury when a retractor is placed on the sacrum during combined pelvic/acetabular fixation through Stoppa and lateral-window exposures; this is an anatomy-based inference, as the exact operative passage was not retrieved.

entities.name: Sacral retractor hazard
observations: For the described Stoppa plus lateral-window surgery, the likely structure at risk from a retractor placed on the sacrum is the L5 nerve root; the precise matching source passage was not obtained.

entities.name: PMID:30413546
observations: Community health-center EHR difference-in-differences analysis (2012–2015): ACA Medicaid expansion reduced uninsured diabetes-related visits and increased preventive care access; HbA1c screening rates increased, particularly in expansion-state prediabetes and no-diabetes cohorts.

entities.name: PMID:37844212
observations: MEPS study of 25,616 U.S. adults with diagnosed diabetes assessed six ADA-recommended preventive services; subgroup trend analyses found declining dental visits among uninsured adults and declining cholesterol testing among Medicaid-insured adults.

entities.name: PMID:38100007
observations: FQHC cohort of 106,114 adults: private insurance versus Medicaid was associated with greater checkup completion during COVID period (adjusted relative risk 1.15, 95% CI 1.10–1.19); checkups associated with higher mammography and chronic illness detection/treatment.

entities.name: Insurance and preventive care
observations: Across U.S. safety-net studies, insurance status is associated with preventive visit/service receipt; direction varies by service and comparison, and retrieved evidence does not establish a uniform advantage for every service.
